title: Jagged Chewy Spanish Seafood Fideua
description: A charred and chewy Spanish dish featuring seafood and gelatine leafs, perfect for a hangover cure. This pescatarian friendly fideua is made with a unique tadka spice blend.
instructions: Soak the gelatine leafs in cold water for 5 minutes before draining and setting aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the tadka spice blend.
Add the shrimp, mussels, and clams to the skillet and cook until the seafood is lightly browned.
Add the fideua noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the seafood and spice blend.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the soaked gelatine leafs to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
